title: Note Plugin Migration To Crate And Taxonomy Consolidation
description: Migrate the 🗒️note plugin from its old 8-crate constitutional layout (manifest/artifact, app facade, and 6 module crates: engine/dsl/op/pack/protocol/ui) to the new single-crate taxonomy layout at ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🗒️note/📦️packages/🦀️rust, following the proven recipe in CRATE-CONSOLIDATION-AND-PLUGIN-TAXONOMY-RESTRUCTURE/📋️TEMPLATE.md. Includes: package scaffolding, lib.rs with taxonomy #[path] wiring, Cargo.toml union with workspace=true adoption, code migration per TEMPLATE §4 mapping table, Command decomposition via app_commands!, manifest stitch, per-node tests + wire-format guards, wire-baseline capture/diff proof, and deletion of the 8 old crates once the new crate is green. Ends with a registrar handoff block (no self-application of registrar changes). Strictly scoped to ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🗒️note/** — no edits to root Cargo.toml, other plugins, or registry scripts.
summary: Migrated the 🗒️note plugin from its old 8-crate constitutional layout to the new single-crate taxonomy layout at ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🗒️note/📦️packages/🦀️rust (crate semio-s-plugin-note), following TEMPLATE.md precisely. NoteCommand (40 variants) decomposed via app_commands! into 13 command-group files under 🎮️commands/*; NoteDocument/NoteBlockNode etc. moved to 🗿️artifacts/🗒️note/ with diff/op/dsl/pack/spr split; NoteConfig/NoteConfigOperation moved to app-level 🦀️config.rs; two windows (composite/navigator) each with their own 🎚️options/* measure files; 3 panels (document/catalogue/inspection). Baseline: 8 old crates had no consolidated test count on file (old ui crate was pre-existing broken, same unbalanced-Ok(...) corruption pattern as TEMPLATE §12.3 documents, fixed as part of the app_commands! port). New crate: 63/63 tests pass, cargo check clean, wasm32-wasip2 check clean, clippy -D warnings clean. Wire-format proof: captured a 41-row before-baseline (one value per NoteCommand variant plus the SetHover None/Some pair) via a temporary overlay on the old protocol crate, then a matching after-dump from the new crate — byte-for-byte identical (print_op text, byte length, and hex all match for all 41 rows; only cosmetic row-label formatting differed). Found and fixed one real gap: create_note_app() was missing the now-mandatory .document(["semio","note"]) builder call (old manifest never had it, framework's build_definition() now asserts non-empty document segments) — added, matching the writer/shooting convention. Deleted all 8 old crate directories only after the new crate was fully green. Relocated the orphan 🛂️manifest.jsonblocks.manifest.json data file to 🗿️artifacts/🗒️note/🛂️manifest.json (unreferenced anywhere, same as flow's precedent). No cross-plugin dependents found for any old crate name. Note: a duplicate ticket/session briefly worked the same slug concurrently and produced much of the scaffolding; both efforts converged on the same design and were reconciled into one consistent, verified tree (one invented wasm-bindgen bridge file with no basis in the old plugin was found and removed).
